profile.reading:
This record covers a single map point at Via Giovanni Pascoli 4 in the hamlet of Caorsa, in the comune of Affi in the province of Verona, Veneto, northern Italy, carrying the business name 4ServiceSolutions and a data centre tag. Affi is a village of a few thousand people at the southern end of Lake Garda, best known regionally as a motorway junction on the A22 Brenner corridor with a retail and logistics park beside it. Nothing about the location or the record establishes a data centre, and this registry does not claim one.

The map history is short and completely traceable. The OpenStreetMap node was created on 9 May 2020 by a Veneto mapper in a changeset containing exactly one object creation, with the Italian comment aggiunta azienda, meaning a company was added, made in the iD editor over Bing aerial imagery. The node carries the name, a full street address and telecom=data_center. It has never been edited since, by anyone. The same changeset also closed two unrelated and long stale map notes, one from 2019 about a quarry near the village of Volargne and one left by a lorry driver marking the end of a journey, so the edit was routine local tidying rather than a survey of this business.

That leaves the classification resting on one mapper's single unreviewed choice, and there is no independent way to test it. The node has no website tag. The two obvious domains for a company of this name, 4servicesolutions.it and 4servicesolutions.com, do not resolve in DNS at all, so there is no operator site to read. Italian company register lookups through public directory services were refused this session, and searches were unavailable. No registration number, VAT number, sector code, ownership or trading status could be established. The name itself is no help either way, because service solutions is a generic phrase used by facilities management firms, cleaning and catering contractors, industrial maintenance companies and information technology providers alike.

What can be said honestly is this. There is a business at a residential scale address in a small Veneto village, one contributor recorded it as a data centre in 2020, and nothing has confirmed or corrected that in the five years since. This registry publishes no capacity, no floor area, no operator and no power figure for it, and treats the row as an unverified business point rather than as a facility.
profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05 from 765 characters. New evidence: node 7500843901 is a single version object created 2020-05-09 by mapper luca scamperle in changeset 84937252, a one object changeset (created_count 1) with comment Aggiunta azienda, iD 2.17.3, Bing aerial imagery, Italian locale. The changeset also carries closed:note 1722099 and 1994382, both fetched this pass and both unrelated to this business (a misplaced 2019 note about a quarry near Volargne, and a note left by a lorry driver marking his destination), so the edit was general local cleanup. Nominatim reverse geocode confirms 4 Via Giovanni Pascoli, Caorsa, Affi, Verona 37010. Negative results recorded honestly: 4servicesolutions.it and 4servicesolutions.com both fail DNS resolution (NXDOMAIN), ufficiocamerale.it returned 403 and reportaziende.it 429 to automated requests, Nominatim name search returns nothing, and WebSearch quota was exhausted this session. No registry, VAT or sector data could be obtained, so the row is filed as an unverified business point with no asserted facility function.
